subject: Supplemental credit request for DataForge RFP bake-off
messages:
From: Andrew Smith <andrew@dataforge.ai>

Cc: Kate Lee <kate.procurement@dataforge.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — extra eval credits for shifted bake-off

Hi Neha,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick situation on our end: the evaluation window for the RFP got bumped by the buyer to Nov 10–12. That compresses our time to run side-by-side tests against the incumbent and two other vendors.

We used the initial pilot allocation but we’re going to blow through tokens running end-to-end prompts and a reranking pass. Any chance Redwood can provide a short supplemental credit top-up to cover an extra 200k tokens and a temporary throughput bump for three days? If you can, we’ll highlight Redwood in our bake-off summary and include the latency/cost appendix your team requested.

Appreciate any flexibility — Kate from procurement is cc’d for formalities.

Thanks,
Andrew
Andrew Smith
Senior ML Eng, DataForge Analytics
andrew@dataforge.ai

Andrew —

Thanks for flagging this. We can potentially support a supplemental credit and a short burst plan, but I need to confirm with finance and get an operational schedule in place. Can you confirm:
- exact token estimate (you said ~200k — is that sufficient?)
- which model variants you’ll run (open-llama-70B / redwood-2-small / both?)
- days you expect the throughput bump (Nov 10–12)?

I’ll get internal approval and circle back with a concrete offer and a DocuSign if procurement wants that.

Aditya / Rishi — forwarding a request from DataForge. They need ~200k tokens and a 3-day burst window for a late-shifted bake-off (Nov 10–12). They’re running both the open-llama-70B and redwood-2-small variants; they’ll do a heavy rerank pass which is why tokens spike.

My recommendation:
- Grant a 200k token supplement (hosted credit)
- Provide a temporary small pool burst config (2x baseline concurrency) for Nov 10–12, with auto-revert
- Require completion of the attached pilot-credit-schedule.xlsx (ops) and a short supplemental-offer.pdf that they can sign (DocuSign)

Rishi — do we need a deal-level approval threshold for this size? Marissa suggested we treat this as a sales incentive to secure case study rights.

If we greenlight, I’ll send a formal offer to Andrew and Kate.

Thanks,
Neha
